data.overview: A series of eerie tableaux—grave robbers, interrogations, possessed nuns, and a midnight witches' gathering—examines the idea that medieval witchcraft accusations grew from the same hysteria later diagnosed as illness. Its scholarly argument repeatedly gives way to macabre, mischievous spectacle.
data.tagline: Are old superstitions ever truly gone?
data.title: Witchcraft and Wonder
